Synopsis:
Two guards standing by a fountain, one a long-lived gnome Harper and one a rough-and-ready Flaming Fist human. The Fist is on edge and none too friendly, the Harper is calmer and more forthcoming.

Off‑screen the city is reeling: cultists torched a nearby pig‑sty and carried off Grand Duke Ravengard, so a rescue party is forming and local commanders (Jaheira and the counsellor Florrick) are issuing orders. Ulthred assumes the player is an outsider and is short and hostile, while Essius is pragmatic and more likely to welcome any help; Florrick is inside on the ground floor, strategising and the obvious person to brief.
